third_party_evaluations.summary: Practical malware reverse engineering exam: unpacking, custom packer analysis, and full report.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded hands-on unpacking, custom-packer analysis and report demonstrate deep malware-research specialization; senior rigor in that narrow discipline does not equate to general expert security responsibility.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Practical unpacking, custom-packer analysis and a full report establish a focused malware reverse-engineering specialty. The senior-rigor factor is meaningful, but the three-year profile and narrow scope do not imply general expert incident-response responsibility.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded practical unpacking, custom-packer analysis and full report provide deep malware reverse-engineering evidence. That narrow technical branch fits specialty despite the expert community hint, rather than implying universal seniority.
